observations.summary: Review found that the JSON status view omitted a field AC2 requires; the tests covered only the text view.

earnedCost: Review: one bounce and one implementer round caught an AC2 fault the tests did not cover.
unproved: Whether the test-writers' coverage of JSON output is a recurring gap: one attempt cannot show a pattern.

recommendation.change: Keep the review as it is; watch whether review keeps catching output-format gaps the tests miss.
recommendation.measurement: Review bounces whose fix changes an output format the tests did not exercise, per attempt, in the next batch.

mustNot: State a review catch rate from one attempt.
Count the bounce as avoidable work because the final tests passed.
